title: Shark Stratos £199.99, Sonos Ray £159 and a 55-inch LG C6 OLED for £1,117
description: Tuesday's checked UK deals: half-price Shark Stratos cordless vac at Currys, Sonos Ray for £159, a Garmin Forerunner 165 at £149.99 and LG's C6 OLED.
intro:
**Today's best buy is the Shark Stratos cordless vacuum (IZ400UK) at £199.99 from Currys, half its £399.99 list price.** The other standouts are the Sonos Ray soundbar at £159 on Amazon and the Garmin Forerunner 165 at £149.99 from Argos, both about £100 or more under their usual prices.

It's a short list today. We only include deals we could confirm from a source dated today or yesterday, and several retailer sites didn't let us check prices this morning, so we've left out anything we couldn't back up. Buy now or wait? The Shark, the Sonos and the Garmin are fine to buy now. The Ninja Creami went lower last Black Friday, so hold off on that one.

deals.name: Shark Stratos Cordless Vacuum Cleaner with Anti Hair Wrap Plus (IZ400UK), Rose Gold
deals.note: £399.99 is Shark's list price rather than a recent selling price, but £199.99 is still a strong price for a Stratos. The anti-hair-wrap brush roll is the reason to pick it if you have long hair or pets in the house. Our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) has prices for the rest of the range.

deals.name: Sonos Ray compact soundbar
deals.note: £120 off and a sensible upgrade over built-in TV speakers for a bedroom or smaller living room. It doesn't do Dolby Atmos, so if you want that, look at the LG below.

deals.name: Garmin Forerunner 165 GPS running watch
deals.note: About £100 off Garmin's entry-level running watch with a bright AMOLED screen and built-in GPS. A good Christmas present for someone training for a first 10K or half marathon.

deals.name: LG OLED55C66LB 55-inch OLED evo C6 4K Smart TV
deals.note: LG's own site has knocked about £580 off this year's 55-inch C6 and includes a five-year warranty, which is better than most shops offer. If you don't need the newest model, last year's C5 is usually cheaper still; our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) compares them.

deals.name: LG US80TR 5.1.3 Wireless Sound Bar with Dolby Atmos
deals.note: A full surround setup with wireless rear speakers, subwoofer and upward-firing Atmos channels for £399. Currys shows a £1,099 'was' price, which looks like the old launch figure rather than what it has sold for recently, so judge it on the £399 alone.

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi soft-serve ice cream maker
deals.note: £51 off, but Ninja's soft-serve Creami dropped to about £273 last Black Friday, so it's worth waiting a few weeks. Our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) lists the prices to aim for.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for the Shark Stratos, the Sonos Ray or the Garmin: all three are big cuts from known retailers, and Black Friday rarely beats prices like these by much. The Creami is the one to leave for now. T3 still expects Amazon's own Black Friday sale to start around 19 November, and our [Amazon Black Friday guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) explains how to time a Prime free trial for it. Black Friday itself is on 27 November; see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for every retailer's dates.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

We couldn't confirm any new beauty gift set prices today, but yesterday's picks are covered in this week's spotlight, [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/). If you'd rather keep warm than smell nice, our [keep warm spotlight](/spotlight/keep-warm-for-less-winter-2026/) has heated throws and electric blankets.
